# Development Plan Overview

::: {.content-visible unless-format="revealjs"}
The project is splinted into work packages (WP0–WP7) over 6 weeks.

**Detailed work package specifications** (tasks, deliverables, quality criteria, and dependencies) are provided in [Chapter 5: Project Schedule & Work Packages](05-project-schedule-and-workpackages.qmd).
:::

## Communication & Oversight

**Weekly Sync**:

- Review completed tasks

- Discuss blockers & dependencies

- Update Kanban board

- Plan next week

**Status Reporting**: Mira provides bi-weekly status to lecturer
